name: Simple mean, opponent-adjusted
description: Unweighted mean points for/allowed per team, adjusted for the average quality of opponents already faced.

G1 data integrity.note: Inputs are official NFL.com pages; each prediction uses only games played before the forecast week (no look-ahead).

G2 out-of-sample.note: Walk-forward evaluation over weeks 3-10; no random row splits.

G4 significance.note: 95% Bonferroni-adjusted bootstrap CI for spread-MAE improvement: [0.029, 1.968].

G5 stability.note: Improvement positive in 75% of evaluated weeks (minimum 60%).

G6 calibration.note: Largest gap between predicted and observed cover rate: 0.071 (tolerance 0.12).

G7 not the benchmark.note: The league-constant benchmark is excluded from rewards by definition.

G8 shadow period.note: 0 of the pre-registered Week 11 forward bets are graded. A historical walk-forward backtest cannot open the shadow period; it stays closed until the registered forward window is played and graded.

signal.basis: out-of-sample spread-MAE improvement vs the league-constant benchmark, gates-based; computed from official NFL.com game results only.

staking.basis: blank - staking requires a licensed odds feed (spread / total / moneyline prices) and bankroll rules. The NFL publishes no official odds, so no staking figure is published and no lucky staking run can masquerade as signal.
